reading.body:
ServiceNow is a profitable public company headquartered in Santa Clara with $13.3 billion in revenue for the fiscal year ending December 2025, competing in AI governance and enterprise workflow automation.

Its two recorded products sit in different but related categories. AI Governance, built into the Now Platform, expanded in June 2026 to cover discovery, observation, security, and measurement of AI running across any system, not only ServiceNow's own. Now Assist embeds AI directly into IT service management and HR service delivery workflows. The practical positioning is that governance and automation reinforce each other within the same platform, which reduces integration overhead for organizations already using ServiceNow but creates a switching-cost dependency for those that are not.

The data records 174 points of exposure to California law, which is notable given the company's Santa Clara headquarters and the volume of AI-specific regulation moving through that state. The data does not specify which statutes or regulations those exposures map to, so the figure indicates surface area, not liability. Nothing in the data addresses ServiceNow's own compute infrastructure, data center footprint, or power consumption, so no inference about grid demand or hardware scaling is warranted here.
